finding.exportedParameterWidening: signData, verifySignature and encryptWithPassword parameters go from Uint8Array to the lib BufferSource. This is accepted as a type-level API widening beyond the literal wording of tasks.md 1.1, with identical runtime: on TS 5.8 BufferSource also admits ArrayBuffer and DataView, which Web Crypto handles; on TS 7 it is ArrayBufferView<ArrayBuffer> | ArrayBuffer. The returns of signData and generateKeyPair narrow, which no caller can observe as a break. TS7S1A must record this as a tasks.md 1.1 outcome line.
